author: Atlas
changes: A standalone standard-library helper prints the 04:00 America/Los_Angeles session target, waits with heartbeat output, then dispatches the selected existing data or trader host. Starts at or after 04:00 proceed immediately.
The pending wait pins and observes originating Windows parent-process lifetimes. Ending the launcher task or terminal cancels its pending start, preventing an orphan waiter from starting later.

The package records exact invocation-only edits for both existing launchers and preserves original newline styles and the running data wrapper byte offset. It does not claim ownership of the pre-existing full launcher or host compositions.
The two earlier published source records are preserved historical evidence; this corrected revision supersedes them because it adds cancellation of pending starts when the originating launcher ends.
limitations: Offline checks use fake clocks and synthetic Windows parents, wrappers and hosts; they do not test market connectivity, broker behavior or live trading.
The actual scheduler tests verify pre-session waiting and cancellation. They do not claim observation of the future 03:55 trigger or 04:00 live session transition.
Source publication, common-main integration, Atlas installation and peer installation are separate facts. No peer installation or runtime deployment is asserted.
local_verification: Both existing Atlas Windows scheduled-task launchers were exercised using the final helper before 04:00 on 2026-10-29. Both consoles displayed that they were waiting for the 04:00 Pacific session start.
Stopping the test instances automatically ended their pending Python waiters; no waiter remained and no live host, provider call or trader was started by these tests.
Both 03:55 local schedules and original task definitions were preserved; the data task IgnoreNew setting was restored. Gameplan Trader is disabled as requested.
The original running data collection instance and its process lifetime were preserved.
ownership: Only the six listed additions are published. Existing full launchers, host modules, application source, local configuration, task definitions, raw data, models and private operating state are outside this source record.
peer_applicability: Shared helper, tests, and reviewed launcher adapter package are available on common main. Peer installation requires local exact-byte review against its existing launcher composition and preservation of its own operating bindings; no peer installation is claimed.

runtime_implications.behavior: New early launcher invocations wait visibly until 04:00 Pacific. Existing data collection continues on its original process lifetime. Original independent trader behavior, session renewals, manual stops, symbols and strategy defaults are preserved.

summary: Atlas: 15-minute launchers visibly wait until 04:00 Pacific; ending the originating task cancels a pending start
